question: Do neural factual-history gates improve cumulative return from genuine chosen interventions, including abrupt reversal and delayed actuation, versus a same-data and same-training-budget conventional neural predictor?
null: Specialized P7 router is not consistently superior to trained conventional MLP and random actions in cumulative factual closed-loop outcomes, especially with changed causal delay structure.

design.base_training: unchanged P7 public analytic training generator
design.predeclared_optimization: 1200 AdamW updates with cosine 0.006 to 0.0006; same exact indices, 256 batch, 5.0 gradient clip
eval_structures: instant factually action-conditioned gain with hidden A-B-A reversal
lagged causal effect of previous action, no instantaneous action effect
confounded immediate action effect with +0.20 previous-action nuisance
design.observation_to_decision: 8 common completed factual -1/+1 warmup actions, then 64 closed-loop scored actions; never reveal latent sign, phase schedule, other action results or future consequence to learned models
design.hidden_phase_schedule: A t=0..31, B t=32..55, A t=56..71; t not input to trained model
design.action_budget: every policy receives exactly 64 action decisions ±1, identical opportunities, common exogenous noise per world/seed and the same initial factual history
design.informed_oracle_use: evaluation upper-bound diagnostic only; it sees true regime and in lagged family future sign, no model is given that information
directional_DEV_thresholds: router per-seed average factual return per action >= MLP + 0.03 in EACH structural family
router per-seed average factual return per action >= random + 0.05 in EACH structural family
MLP per-seed average return >= random + 0.05 in EACH structural family
router and MLP each within 0.10 of informed upper bound in EACH structural family
design.integrity_pass: all episodes run with exact common prefix, identical nonzero action budgets, factual feedback only, models receive true AdamW updates on P7 fit only, per-episode complete receipts; no performance win required
design.cost_accounting: actual optimizer steps, sample-index SHA, parameters and process wall-clock; FLOPs/fully trained competence not independently qualified
design.owner_runner: existing TTT-HYBRID-GPU-WIN project isolated Windows WSL CPU qualification
